verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a Balance product for receiving real-time balance information, which supplies now-fresh balance data on request. However, the pack never shows a general on-demand refresh endpoint for transactions or other account data; Transactions is described as staying up to date via webhooks, which is push, not on-demand. missing for 10: an explicit API refresh endpoint for connected-account data beyond balances, documented refresh semantics (timing, async completion, rate limits/cost), independent or hands-on corroboration.
